criteria.contract: Same-owner head and physically present consenting adult direct retainer agree on a bounded castellan appointment, replacing earlier appointments without transferring ownership, service, troops or debts
Appointment history grants only local administration and store receipt within existing monthly limits; head-only political acts and budget changes remain restricted
Explicit local store custody acceptance records dated owner-separated quantities without creating stock or claiming ownership; replacement preserves prior records and outstanding freight
Military possession conflicting with recorded owner suspends new administrative disposals and deliveries at the actual site; no historical operation is retroactively invalidated

Castellan reports bind to the original appointment and dated owner-separated stock; physical delivery/opening controls remote knowledge, known failure permits bounded same-observation resend, NPC reports derive from actual local administration, and generation recovery/future equality covers both office and letters

limits: Explicit v20 only. Same-owner local head/consenting adult direct retainer agree bounded castellan administration and owner-separated dated custody. No legal annexation, general hereditary succession, political head power or automatic transfer of troops/property/debts. Store acknowledgment does not physically move stock; actual freight receipt separately uses the appointed local receiver. Occupation blocks new community/treasury disposals and house freight receipt; not all military/private property transactions. NPC reports require actual local administration and present authority; manual resend requires failure knowledge at that time and preserves the original observation. NPC automatic resend is deferred; earlier stewardship reports remain separate. Full3327/GUI NOT_RUN.
